title: Evidence-pack concurrency matrix
target: Evidence-pack generator for one, five, and ten reports
contract: Evidence-pack payload digest, family status, provider-call count, rate-cap enforcement, and estimated cost remain unchanged.
summary: Added a deterministic concurrency matrix; no production worker configuration changed because no alternative proved faster across the supported batch sizes.
why_equivalent: Every profile uses the same generator, registry, prompt preparation, pack normalization, and deterministic schema-valid model responses; only the local worker and shared in-flight limits vary.

checks.name: Full matrix outcomes
checks.detail: All 75 profile/batch results retained matching digests, quality, rate caps, and zero estimated cost.

workload: Six production evidence-pack families; one, five, and ten reports; every 1-5 worker and 1-5 shared-slot pair; two warmups and seven measured runs; deterministic 30 ms model latency.
limitations: The deterministic local model boundary proves generator scheduling and shared-cap behavior, not a live provider's rate limit or latency.
residual_risks: A controlled live canary is required before altering production global model-concurrency limits.
notes: The fastest raw ten-report profile was 1x5, but its 2.41% median gain did not clear the 7.34% noise threshold and it regressed one-report latency; the current 5x5 setting remains unchanged.
